subject: Genetics
title: Pharmacogenomics
description: A quick, practical guide to Pharmacogenomics.

hook.text: The same drug saves one patient and kills another. The difference is often in their DNA. One size doesn't fit.

buildup.text: Your CYP450 genes determine how fast you metabolize drugs. Fast metabolizers need higher doses. Slow ones overdose.

discovery.text: Pharmacogenomic tests now guide prescriptions for blood thinners, painkillers, and antidepressants. DNA informs dosing.

twist.text: Adverse drug reactions kill over 100,000 Americans yearly. Many are predictable with a simple genetic test.

climax.text: The FDA now lists 300+ drugs with pharmacogenomic info. The genome project made personalized medicine real.

punchline.text: Your genes decide which medicine works. Now we can check first.
